significance: A four-armed Bhadrakali shrine at Puthenpeedika, first built beside the Thiruvanikavu temple and moved to its present site at Thoniyakavu after a devaprasnam. It takes part in the Arattupuzha Pooram, and in October 2020 its administration passed from the Nair families that had held it to the Cochin Devaswom Board.
story: The goddess here is held to be the sister deity of Thiruvanikavu, and to have pointed out the new site at Thoniyakavu herself.
